vb_textbox.text: The pattern which dictates which gnome gives you the basket with higher number of mushrooms seems to be based on the colors of the gnomes, at least for the majority of the time. There are some oddities to this though, as you might see yourself where the pattern is suddenly broken but for me, it seemed that pushing through with the same approach still gave successful results but not as often. At few points, the color of the gnome that gives you higher number is either swapped or a group of colors are swapped for another group of two colored gnomes. This happened in my case and I haven't myself found any specific reasons to believe anything other than color has any meaning as to which gnome gives you what amount of mushrooms. The basket's colors themselves did not seem to make much difference in my case too, unless that's related to what colored gnome gives you the basket in the first place. Good luck!
